Condition.title: Condition
Condition.description: Create a condition that must be met to ask a question

ConditionTriggerValue.title: ConditionTriggerValue
ConditionTriggerValue.description: A value to trigger a condition

message.title: Message
message.default: Please fill out this short survey by

error_message.title: Error Message
error_message.default: Please contact one of the staff members to receive a survey link.

EvaluationSurvey.title: EvaluationSurvey
EvaluationSurvey.description:
Information for evaluation survey hosted on surveyxact.
If key is supplied, the interview id will be prefilled and sent to the variable named id.

Image.title: Image
Image.description:
An image to show the interviewee
path [str]: A path to the image
description [str]: A description of the image used to guide the probing agent
alt [str]: The alt text for the image for accessibility

InterviewGuideContent.title: InterviewGuideContent
InterviewGuideContent.description:
A guide for the interviewer to follow during the interview.
questions [list[QuestionSection]]: A list of sections of questions that all revolve around the same topic.
framing [str]: A description of the interview and its purpose. Only used by the model.
intro [str]: An introduction to the interview. Displayed to the interviewee.
outro [str]: An outro to the interview. Displayed to the interviewee.

Question.title: Question
Question.description:
A question that can be asked to the interviewee
description [str]: A description of the question, may be used to reformulate the question and improve the relevance of the probes.
main_question [str]: The question to ask the interviewee
probes [list[str]]: A list of possible follow-up questions to ask the interviewee
max_probes [int]: The maximum number of follow-up questions to ask the interviewee
image [str]: A path to an image to show the interviewee
user_image [bool]: Whether the user should be able to upload an image as a response

QuestionSection.title: QuestionSection
QuestionSection.description:
A section of questions that all revolve around the same topic
meta [str]: A meta description of the topic, used to frame the questions.
questions [list[str]]: A list of questions that all revolve around the same topic.

QuestionContext.title: QuestionContext
QuestionContext.description:
The index of a question in a section
section [int]: The index of the section
question [int]: The index of the question
